explain.say: Will it rain tomorrow? Will you roll a six? Probability is a number from 0 to 1 that tells you how likely something is. 0 means impossible. 1 means certain. Look at the bars.

explain.say: Like rolling a 7 on a normal dice! Now, a coin has 2 sides, and each is equally likely. Heads is 1 out of 2, so its probability is one half. Look at the circle: half is shaded.
A dice has 6 faces, and only one shows a 6. So the probability of rolling a 6 is 1 out of 6, one sixth. Look at the one shaded slice. Is that likely or unlikely?

Unlikely! And not rolling a 6 is five sixths. One sixth plus five sixths makes 1. Well done! Wow: a 70 percent chance of rain is 0.7 on this scale. Challenge: a bag has 3 red sweets and 7 green. What is the probability of picking red?

faq.q: What does a probability of 0 mean?
faq.a: It means the event is impossible, like rolling a 7 on a normal six-sided dice.

faq.q: What does a probability of 1 mean?
faq.a: It means the event is certain to happen, like the sun rising tomorrow.

faq.q: How do you work out a probability?
faq.a: Count the ways the event can happen, and divide by all the equally likely outcomes. Rolling a 6 is 1 way out of 6, so one sixth.
asks: What is the probability of rolling a 6?

faq.q: Why do the probabilities add up to 1?
faq.a: Something must happen. Either you roll a 6 or you do not, so one sixth plus five sixths covers everything, which is 1.
asks: Why do all outcomes add to 1?

faq.q: What is the probability of a red sweet from 3 red and 7 green?
faq.a: There are 10 sweets and 3 are red, so the probability is 3 out of 10, or 0.3.
asks: Probability of red from 3 red and 7 green

facts: The probability of an event not happening is 1 minus the probability that it happens.

quiz.say: A spinner has 4 equal parts, and 1 is blue. What is the probability of landing on blue?
quiz.why: 1 way out of 4 equally likely parts is one quarter.

wrong.1: One third compares blue with the other 3 parts, not with all 4.
wrong.2: A probability can never be more than 1.
